why_alignment_is_required_not_cosmetic.mechanism: candidate_commit.product_digest() hashes parquet FILE bytes (sha256 per file)
why_alignment_is_required_not_cosmetic.consequence: two machines with different pandas write different bytes for identical logical data, so commit_id can never match cross-host regardless of data equality

measured.conclusion: file bytes differ for the same dataframe

why_alignment_is_required_not_cosmetic.root_cause: cache_compiler_daily_incremental_r1.py:564 `g.to_parquet(fp, index=False)` has no explicit schema; pandas 3 defaults object->str, timestamp[ns]->timestamp[us]

read_semantics_equivalence.dtype_change_only: code: object -> str；date 读回仍为 datetime64[ns]；值/行数/样本未变
